title: Pitagna mod extension
description: a addon to my mod:Pitagna mod dd a new dimension create a nether protal with a netherite block and use pitagna Pitagna Dimension Portal Igniter and you have pitagna teleporter to teleport you(at a distance often far away)and pitagna chest
body: a addon for [pitagna mod](https://modrinth.com/mod/pitagna-mod) to use please install this mod:[pitagna mod](https://modrinth.com/mod/pitagna-mod) this addon add a new dimension create a nether protal with a netherite block and use pitagna Pitagna Dimension Portal Igniter to use this dimension and add a pitagna teleporter right click and a pitagna_temple a small house in jungle with pitagna chest(give to you 15emerald or explode)
